_about: Big events every My PC's calendar shows (merged into events-ma.json by tools/fetch-events.mjs, read by js/core/events.js). d / e = first / last day (YYYY-MM-DD), id = ucl | uclsemi | uclfinal | afcon | worldcup | morocco | any word (the name comes from the ev_<id> string, else t), time = HH:MM (optional), t = a title for an id without a string. ESPN adds the actual matches 30 days ahead; admins can also add events in the App Store Manager > Settings > Events.
